$janet.$comment: Not JSON Schema. Read by scripts/Test-OutputContracts.ps1, which is the point of the file living here rather than being generated.

contract.description: Bumped only by a format change. An engine change that moves this number is a mistake in one direction; a format change that does not is a mistake in the other.

assembly.description: File name of the assembly that was read.

folder.description: Directory it was read from. Absolute, so this envelope is not portable between machines.

siblings.description: Assemblies beside it. 1 means the dependencies cannot resolve.

typesUnloadable.description: Types that failed to load. The rest are still reported.

matched.description: Types matching the filter, before the cap.

truncated.description: True when the cap bit. Stated, never silent.

membersDropped.description: Members left out because a type in their signature could not be resolved. Always present: an absent field would make 'nothing was dropped' and 'this build does not report it' look the same.

siblingWarning.description: Present ONLY when there is something to say, so its presence is the signal. Was a PowerShell warning stream, which no MCP client ever saw.

baseType.description: Null for an interface, and for a type whose base could not be resolved. The two are not distinguished here.

type.description: The property, field or return type. Empty for a member kind that carries none -- an event, for instance.
